claim_under_test: SEALED: FoX-Pro-exact (published arXiv 2503.02130 Pro block) acquires the MQAR recall circuit on pairs80@3e15 where standard transformer never does. Non-claim robustness grid tests whether transformer's failure is an artifact of a single LR/budget/token-count choice (reference: transformer 0/8 @3e15 campaign n, 0/16 across LR sweep @3e15 campaign w, 0/3 @6e15) -- descriptive only, does not gate the core claim's PASS/FAIL.
token_matched_control_design: fpt_foxpro=104005152, fpt_transformer=96770304 (measured via train.flops_per_token at this exact d/heads/hidden/panel). foxpro's actual token count at the core claim's 3e15 FLOP budget is 28815360 tokens (steps_a=1267, steps_b=140); transformer's OWN 3e15 budget gives it more tokens (31001246 vs foxpro's 28844724, since foxpro's Pro block has ~8.4% more params than base transformer at this config -- param counts intentionally NOT re-matched, consistent with ao's precedent 'FLOP budget matched by the trainer as always'). token_matched_budget=2788471147069440 gives transformer the SAME token count foxpro actually saw, isolating the token-count confound from the FLOP-budget confound.
